verdict.rationale: Gecko Security is an AI code-security scanner, so SBOM generation is a fair axis for this kind of product. Its documentation covers vulnerability findings, call chains, patches, PR checks, an API, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing mentions generating an SPDX or CycloneDX bill of materials for a project or image.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image
